title: Commander

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Allows chat messages to be used in logic systems

body:
"Activates an output when the assigned phrase is in a chat message. Outputs 10.0 if it is the owner, outputs 1.0 if it is a random player."

The Commander is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It outputs a signal if a player chats something that matches its assigned phrase.

Functionality

The Commander will emit a signal when anyone chats the assigned value. This will match any part of the message: if the Commander is set to listen to the word "blue", it will also activate if someone says "I like blueberries ". If the chatter is the owner of the property, it emits a signal strength of 10; if the chatter is any other player, it emits a signal strength of 1. This is a momentary pulse, and the value will return to 0 approximately 0.5 seconds after emitting the signal.


Its important to remember that other players can activate your commander to avoid this you can connect your commander to an and gate with a number interface set to 10 this way other players can’t trigger a wire signal.

The owner of the property can interact with the Commander to assign it a message to listen for, up to 150 characters in length. Players can use the emote prefix to make "private" commands. For example, setting the message to "/e toggle", and then chatting "/e toggle", will activate the Commander without actually chatting a message.
